data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'gaththabah' which means 'to be sweet smelling' or 'to have a pleasant fragrance'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess an attractive and sweet nature. The name Gathbiyya carries the meaning “Sweet, pleasing scent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gathbiyya usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet, pleasing scent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
